about_the_game:
Story

Step into the dark and perilous world of Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch; a challenging, gothic roguevania. Play as Ayana Crimson - known as the Bloodbreaker - a day-walking vampire with a taste for demon blood. Blending the best elements of the roguelite and Metroidvania genres, Bloodbreaker aims to deliver an experience that is as rewarding as it is unforgiving.

When her brother Matthew is captured by the enigmatic white witch Brendowyn Sangrianon, Ayana must descend into the Labyrinth - a sprawling maze steeped in ancient magic and corruption. In her journey to save her brother, Ayana will uncover the truth about her family's cursed lineage and Matthew's uncontrollable powers.

Game Features

Classic Gothic Aesthetic: Enter the Labyrinth; brought to life with strikingly haunting gothic visuals and an atmospheric soundtrack. From moonlit courtyards to decaying cathedrals, every area is steeped in corruption and despair

Intense Combat: Engage in fast, responsive combat that encourages players to chain attack combos, dodges and unleash powerful abilities to defeat enemies. Using the Blood Ascension System, upgrade Ayana's stats, unlock new abilities, and refine her combat skills to aid her survival in the Labyrinth

Death is not the End: When Ayana fails, her collected Blood Orbs manifest into a formidable Blood Remnant. To recover her lost power, Ayana can incite a battle - but beware: failure means losing your orbs forever

Dangerous Traversal: Enemies are not the only dangers in the Labyrinth. Ayana will have to navigate deadly traps and platforming challenges that will put your timing, precision, and reflexes to the test

Vampiric Abilities: Harness Ayana's vampiric abilities by consuming weakened enemies to restore Blood Points. Ayana can use these points to heal herself and keep the fight going

Ever-Changing Labyrinth: The Labyrinth shifts its layout with every visit. No two runs are the same, as rooms rearrange, enemies respawn, and treasures relocate, keeping exploration fresh and unpredictable

Customise your playstyle: Tailor your approach to combat by choosing from a diverse arsenal of weapons at your dispoal - from scythes and swords to twin daggers and guns. Equip Charms and discover hidden synergies that best align with your playstyle

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
